page_title: CRE 0-0 PAR | Cremonese v Parma 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 16:8.

90+4' Parma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90' A dangerous attempt from Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) was aimed to the top left corner, but Zion Suzuki pulls off a superb save and stops this one. Cremonese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Here comes a substitution. Milan Djuric (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Patrick Cutrone.
86' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Parma have a free kick.
85' The number of offsides is – 6:0.
84' Cremonese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Adrian Bernabe Garcia and he is replaced by Christian Ordonez (Parma).
84' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pontus Almqvist (Parma) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Mathias Lovik.
83' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
82' Cremonese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
80' Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Parma.
79' A pass by Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
76' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese) replaces Antonio Sanabria.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) will replace Alessio Zerbin.
76' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) serves up a nice cross, but Zion Suzuki punches the ball away.
72' A cooling break is underway.
69' Federico La Penna blows his whistle. Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) commits a foul after dangerous play. Parma have a free kick from a promising distance.
68' Substitution. Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) has come on for Mateo Pellegrino.
67' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
66' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
65' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
64' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
63' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

61' A precise low pass is received by Patrick Cutrone (Parma), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emanuele Valeri (Parma).
60' The foul by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
59' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
57' It's time for a substitution. Romano Floriani (Cremonese) comes on in place of Jari Vandeputte.
57' The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.

56' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Emil Audero was alert and the score remains the same. Parma get a corner.
53' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

52' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
51' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Federico La Penna blows for a foul. Cremonese get a free kick.
49' The Cremonese players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
47' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes a direct free kick.

47' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Federico La Penna no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Cremonese.
46' Davide Nicola makes a switch. Federico Ceccherini is coming on in place of Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Federico La Penna blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
44' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) heads on.
39' Cremonese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
37' Federico La Penna blows his whistle as Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Cremonese win a free kick.
36' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

32' A neat pass is well received by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
30' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
26' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) commits a foul during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Cremonese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

26' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for an infringement. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
23' 36:64 – the latest ball possession ratio.
22' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
17' A pass by Oliver Sorensen (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
16' Davide Nicola is forced to make a change. Michele Collocolo is unable to continue due to injury, Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) comes on.
16' It doesn’t look good for Michele Collocolo (Cremonese); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
15' Michele Collocolo (Cremonese) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.

9' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. There is a free kick near the sideline to Parma.
8' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
6' The Cremonese players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
2' Federico La Penna interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese). Parma will take a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Parma will take the kick-off.
Federico La Penna will officiate today.
